neighbours.label: the piece that continues a word opening in mat or мат (mat|rim|ony, mat|ador, Mat|ilda, мат|рос, мат|че), as opposed to whole-token words with the same opening (матч, материал, mattress) and split words with another opening (Mal|aga, Marr|akes|h)
fire: The vicar spoke about matrimony at great length.
The young matador bowed to the crowd.
We read a book about Matilda and the king.
The engineer Matsumoto built the new bridge.
Вчера они смотрели матчи по телевизору.
The port of Matanzas lies in Cuba.
quiet: The vicar spoke about marriage at great length.
A cheap mattress was sold to the crowd.
We read a book about Marrakesh and the king.
The engineer Takahashi built the new bridge.
Вчера они смотрели матч по телевизору.
The port of Malaga lies in Spain.
